# Kedro

> Kedro is an open-source Python framework for building reproducible, maintainable, and modular data engineering and data science pipelines.

A Kedro project is made of nodes (plain Python functions) connected into pipelines through named datasets. The Data Catalog, configured in `conf/base/catalog.yml`, maps those dataset names to storage. Parameters live in `conf/base/parameters.yml` and reach nodes as `params:<name>` inputs. The `kedro` CLI creates, runs, and packages projects.

Start with the [Kedro for LLMs cheatsheet](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_for_llms.md). Every link below points to a Markdown copy of the page. To fetch any other page as Markdown, remove the trailing `/` from its URL and append `.md`, or send `Accept: text/markdown, text/html;q=0.9`. The [full documentation bundle](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/llms-full.txt) has all narrative documentation in one file, without the API reference.

## Agent quick start

- [Kedro for LLMs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_for_llms.md): Single-page cheatsheet with project layout, a minimal pipeline, core API and CLI indices, Data Catalog rules, and common errors with fixes

## Get started

- [Installation](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/install.md): Covers installation prerequisites, Python support policy, quickstart steps, verification methods and alternative setup options
- [Kedro concepts](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/kedro_concepts.md): Introduces basic Kedro elements including nodes, pipelines, the Data Catalog and project directory structure
- [FAQs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/faq.md): Technical FAQs on installing Kedro, notebooks, project development, configuration, Data Catalog and pipelines
- [Video course](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/course.md): YouTube video course introducing Kedro pipeline building through the spaceflights tutorial
- [Build a pipeline visually](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/pipeline_builder.md): Browser-based drag-and-drop tool for designing Kedro pipelines without installation

## Tutorials

- [Spaceflight tutorial](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/spaceflights_tutorial.md): Overview and steps of the 30-minute spaceflights tutorial, which builds nodes and pipelines for a price-prediction model
- [Spaceflight tutorial template](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/tutorial_template.md): Creates the spaceflights project with kedro new and the spaceflights-pandas starter, then installs its dependencies
- [Set up data](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/set_up_data.md): Adds datasets to the data folder and registers them in Kedro's Data Catalog
- [Create a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/create_a_pipeline.md): Builds a data processing pipeline that prepares data and creates a model input table
- [Add another pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/add_another_pipeline.md): Adds a data science pipeline using scikit-learn LinearRegression with parameters and model registration
- [Settings](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/settings.md): Explains settings.py application settings, such as Hooks registration and library components, and project metadata in pyproject.toml
- [Test a project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/test_a_project.md): Covers unit testing for nodes, integration testing for pipelines and testing best practices
- [FAQs (Kedro Spaceflights tutorial)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/spaceflights_tutorial_faqs.md): Resolves common errors encountered during the Kedro spaceflights tutorial
- [Notebook tutorial](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/tutorials/notebooks_tutorial.md): Explores Kedro projects in Jupyter notebooks using line magics and the ipython extension

## Create projects

- [Create a Kedro project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/new_project.md): Creates a basic Kedro project using kedro new and explains next steps
- [Create a minimal Kedro project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/minimal_kedro_project.md): Builds a minimal Kedro project from scratch explaining essential components step-by-step
- [Customise a new project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/customise_project.md): Customises a new Kedro project with tools and starters for specific requirements
- [Project tools](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/new_project_tools.md): Customises new projects by specifying tools via CLI inputs or YAML configuration
- [Kedro starters](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/create/starters.md): Explains how to use, version and create custom Kedro project starters

## Configuration

- [Configuration (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/configuration_basics.md): Details Kedro project configuration using OmegaConfigLoader, sources, environments and loading
- [Parameters and credentials (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/parameters_and_credentials.md): Explains how parameters and credentials work conceptually in Kedro projects
- [Templating (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/templating.md): Covers variable interpolation, globals, runtime parameters and resolvers for Kedro configuration
- [Configuration (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_configure_project.md): Configures projects for different scenarios including remote storage and runtime source changes
- [Parameters and credentials (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_use_parameters_and_credentials.md): Shows how to use parameters in pipelines, validate them and load credentials via code or environment variables
- [Templating (How-to Guides)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/how_to_use_templating.md): Applies templating to parameters, catalog files and other configuration using OmegaConfigLoader
- [Config loader migration](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/configure/config_loader_migration.md): Migrates deprecated ConfigLoader and TemplatedConfigLoader to the OmegaConfigLoader class

## Data Catalog

- [Introduction](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/introduction.md): Introduces the Data Catalog as a registry of data sources with concepts and guides
- [Data Catalog (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/data_catalog.md): Explains catalog.yml basics, additional dataset settings such as load_args and credentials, and how the catalog maps dataset names to storage
- [Dataset factories (Concepts)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/kedro_dataset_factories.md): Explains dataset factory patterns, resolution order and pipeline-aware catalog commands
- [Partitioned and incremental datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/partitioned_and_incremental_datasets.md): Explains PartitionedDataset and IncrementalDataset concepts including partition IDs and checkpoints
- [Lazy loading](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/lazy_loading.md): Explains how the DataCatalog defers dataset instantiation until a dataset is first used
- [Configure the Data Catalog](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_configure_the_data_catalog.md): Configures Data Catalog entries with load arguments, credentials, versioning and environment overrides
- [Use dataset factories](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_use_dataset_factories.md): Applies dataset factory patterns for generalising datasets by type, namespace and layer
- [Use partitioned and incremental datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_use_partitioned_and_incremental_datasets.md): Configures and uses PartitionedDataset and IncrementalDataset with partitions, lazy saving and checkpoints
- [Access the Data Catalog in code](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/how_to_access_the_data_catalog_in_code.md): Accesses, configures and manipulates the Data Catalog programmatically in Python code
- [Validate datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/dataset_validation.md): Validates catalog entries using Pandera, custom validators and on-demand checks
- [Data Catalog YAML examples](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/catalog-data/data_catalog_yaml_examples.md): YAML examples for loading and saving text, CSV, pickle and Excel files locally and remotely

## Nodes and pipelines

- [Nodes](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/nodes.md): Creates nodes with args, kwargs, tags, generators and preview functions
- [Pipeline object](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/pipeline_introduction.md): Builds pipelines, merges multiple pipelines, tags them and inspects inputs and outputs
- [Run a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/run_a_pipeline.md): Executes pipelines using runners, custom runners, asynchronous IO and programmatic execution
- [Modular pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/modular_pipelines.md): Creates pipelines with kedro pipeline create, structures pipeline code, uses custom pipeline templates and pipeline-specific dependencies
- [Namespaces](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/namespaces.md): Groups and isolates nodes using namespaces to enable pipeline reuse with different inputs
- [Pipeline registry](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/pipeline_registry.md): Defines pipeline registries with autodiscovery and selective loading in Kedro projects
- [Slice a pipeline](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/slice_a_pipeline.md): Runs subsets of pipelines by inputs, nodes, tags or final nodes and recreates outputs
- [LLM context node](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/build/llm_context_node.md): Constructs LLMContext datasets inside pipelines for downstream LLM execution and orchestration

## Development

- [Dependency management](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/dependencies.md): Declares and installs project-specific dependencies and sets up reproducible environments
- [Logging](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/logging.md): Configures default and advanced logging, custom filters and the rich handler in Kedro
- [Automated testing](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/automated_testing.md): Sets up automated testing with pytest and adds coverage reports using pytest-cov
- [Formatting and linting](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/linting.md): Sets up Python formatting tools and automated linting with pre-commit hooks
- [Inspect a project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/inspect/inspect-project.md): Reads project structure via the inspection API without running nodes or loading data
- [Vibe coding with MCP](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/vibe_coding_with_mcp.md): Installs and uses an MCP server for AI coding assistants in Kedro projects
- [Vibe coding with skills](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/develop/vibe_coding_with_skills.md): Installs kedro-skills to provide AI assistants with Kedro conventions and contextual guidance

## Deployment

- [Overview](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy.md): Provides guides for different Kedro deployment methods and effective node grouping
- [How to package your project](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/package_a_project.md): Builds project documentation and packages a Kedro project as a Python wheel with kedro package
- [How to group your nodes effectively](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/nodes_grouping.md): Groups nodes by pipelines, tags and namespaces for deployment maintainability and control
- [Single-machine deployment](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/single_machine.md): Deploys Kedro on a single production server using containers, packages or CLI
- [Distributed deployment](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/distributed.md): Deploys Kedro in distributed systems by containerising pipelines and converting platform primitives
- [Apache Airflow](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/airflow.md): Runs Kedro pipelines on Apache Airflow with Astronomer, MWAA or Kubernetes clusters
- [Amazon SageMaker](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/amazon_sagemaker.md): Deploys Kedro pipelines on Amazon SageMaker using the kedro-sagemaker plugin
- [Amazon EMR Serverless](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/amazon_emr_serverless.md): Deploys Kedro as Spark jobs on Amazon EMR Serverless with custom Docker images
- [AWS Step Functions](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/aws_step_functions.md): Deploys Kedro pipelines on AWS Step Functions using Lambda and CDK scripts
- [Azure ML pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/azure.md): Deploys Kedro pipelines to Azure ML using the kedro-azureml plugin
- [Dagster](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/dagster.md): Orchestrates Kedro pipelines in Dagster using the kedro-dagster plugin
- [Dask](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/dask.md): Distributes Kedro pipeline execution across Dask clusters for parallel computing
- [Databricks](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/databricks.md): Runs Kedro on Databricks via Git folders, Databricks Connect or the kedro-databricks plugin
- [Kubeflow Pipelines](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/kubeflow.md): Deploys Kedro pipelines on Kubeflow using the kedro-kubeflow plugin
- [Prefect](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/prefect.md): Runs Kedro pipelines using Prefect 2.0 with a self-hosted Prefect Server
- [VertexAI](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/vertexai.md): Runs Kedro pipelines on Vertex AI using the kedro-vertexai plugin
- [Argo Workflows](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/argo.md): Runs Kedro pipelines on Argo Workflows with container-native orchestration on Kubernetes
- [AWS Batch](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/deploy/supported-platforms/aws_batch.md): Deploys Kedro namespaces as AWS Batch jobs with custom runners and container images

## Extend a project

- [Use cases](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/common_use_cases.md): Chooses the right extension mechanism: Hooks, custom datasets, CLI commands, or custom starters
- [Custom datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/how_to_create_a_custom_dataset.md): Creates custom datasets by implementing load, save and describe methods using fsspec
- [Introduction (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/introduction.md): Introduces Kedro Hooks covering specifications, implementations and execution order
- [Common use cases (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/common_use_cases.md): Extends node behaviour, customises dataset IO, loads credentials and debugs pipelines using Hooks
- [Examples (Hooks)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/hooks/examples.md): Tracks memory, validates data, adds observability and changes node inputs using Hooks
- [Kedro sessions](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/session.md): Manages Kedro run lifecycles with KedroSession, KedroServiceSession and project bootstrapping
- [Serving over HTTP](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/serving.md): Starts an HTTP server to trigger pipeline runs and inspect metadata via REST endpoints
- [Custom plugins](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/plugins.md): Creates Kedro plugins with click commands, project context and lazy loading support
- [Custom starters](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/extend/create_a_starter.md): Creates custom Kedro starters using cookiecutter with project variables and aliases

## Integrations and plugins

- [Introduction (IPython and Jupyter)](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython.md): Adds Kedro to existing notebook projects or notebooks to existing Kedro projects
- [Kedro and Jupyter notebooks](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython/kedro_and_notebooks.md): Explores Kedro projects in Jupyter notebooks using line magics and the ipython extension
- [How to add Kedro to Jupyter Notebook](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/notebooks_and_ipython/notebook-example/add_kedro_to_a_notebook.md): Incrementally adds Kedro features to a notebook using YAML configuration and refactoring
- [PySpark](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/pyspark_integration.md): Best practices for PySpark pipelines using built-in datasets, Delta Lake and ThreadRunner
- [MLflow](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/mlflow.md): Integrates MLflow for tracking experiments, packaging runs and deploying models in Kedro
- [DVC](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/dvc.md): Versions datasets and pipelines using DVC with .dvc files and advanced workflows
- [Delta Lake](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/deltalake_versioning.md): Uses Delta tables in Kedro catalogs with interactive inspection and Spark integration
- [Iceberg](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/iceberg_versioning.md): Defines custom datasets for Apache Iceberg tables and inspects them interactively
- [Great Expectations](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/great_expectations.md): Integrates Great Expectations for data quality validation and profiling in Kedro
- [Pandera](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/integrations-and-plugins/pandera.md): Validates data schemas using Pandera with checks for pandas, PySpark and Polars

## IDE support

- [Visual Studio Code & Cursor](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/ide/set_up_vscode.md): Sets up VS Code or Cursor with the Kedro extension, LSP validation and Kedro-Viz
- [PyCharm](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/ide/set_up_pycharm.md): Configures PyCharm run configurations, remote interpreters and catalog validation schemas

## About

- [Kedro architecture](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/architecture_overview.md): Overview of Kedro architecture covering projects, framework, starters, library and extensions
- [Kedro security model](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/security_model.md): Describes Kedro's security model, user responsibilities and vulnerability reporting procedures
- [Glossary](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/getting-started/glossary.md): Defines key Kedro terms including Data Catalog, KedroContext, KedroSession and modular pipelines
- [Kedro's Technical Steering Committee](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/technical_steering_committee.md): Outlines Kedro TSC roles, responsibilities and processes for maintainers, committers and advisors
- [Experimental APIs](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/experimental.md): Explains the @experimental decorator for early-stage APIs and migration expectations
- [Migration guide](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/migration.md): Migrates Kedro projects from 0.18.* to 0.19.* and from 0.19.* to 1.*
- [Kedro telemetry](https://docs.kedro.org/en/stable/about/telemetry.md): Describes anonymised telemetry collection, data fields and consent withdrawal options

## Related projects

- [Kedro-Viz](https://docs.kedro.org/projects/kedro-viz/en/stable/): Interactive visualisation of Kedro pipelines, datasets, and run metadata
- [Kedro-Datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/projects/kedro-datasets/en/stable/): Dataset implementations for the Data Catalog, such as `pandas.CSVDataset` and `spark.SparkDataset`
- [Kedro-MCP](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-mcp): MCP server that gives coding assistants curated Kedro instructions
- [kedro-skills](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-skills): Context files for AI coding assistants working in Kedro projects
- [Kedro plugins](https://github.com/kedro-org/kedro-plugins): Official plugins, including kedro-airflow, kedro-docker, and kedro-telemetry
